verdict.rationale: Windows ships Copilot integration across Microsoft apps and a Windows AI Foundry toolkit, suggesting AI-generated insights are surfaced within the OS/app ecosystem, but evidence is thin on concrete in-product data-driven insights/suggestions (e.g. Recall, Copilot analyzing user files) and lacks independent hands-on validation. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of specific AI insight features (e.g. Copilot analyzing personal data/files), independent corroboration of these features working in practice, and clarity on scope/limitations.
